identity: University of Groningen (Rijksuniversiteit Groningen) BSc Scheikunde, RIO 56857. English-taught Chemistry, 180 EC. Chemistry of Life is the first formal specialisation in Appendix II and none is designated as the default.
sourceUse: The adopted Chemistry appendix controls credits, choice and progression. The public programme page identifies the subject, degree and the three established specialisations. The dated Ocasys programme route is an additional source. Dated Ocasys course payloads corroborate content for specific alignments.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Concepts of Chemistry
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Chemical calculations, measurement error, basic spectroscopy and practical exercises support the partial ENSGATE201 alignment.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Chemical Biology
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Chemical modification and investigation of biomolecules, including synthetic work, differ from the pharmacological study of drug action.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Linear Algebra & Multivariable Calculus for Chemistry
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Vectors, matrices and multivariable calculus corroborate direct quantitative overlap, with the UCR sequence covering the tools in separate units.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Bioenergy, Metabolism and Bioresources
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Metabolism, photosynthesis, fermentation and biomass conversion are studied at the biochemical level, unlike renewable power-system design.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Cellular Chemistry
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Chemical and quantitative views of cellular processes overlap with molecular cell biology.

progression.year-two: Positive study advice in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering.
progression.practicals: First synthesis practical follows Molecules and Organic Chemistry 1. Synthesis Lab 2 follows that practical or the listed LST practical. (Bio)Synthesis and Analysis 3 follows the biochemistry practical and programming. The research practical requires prior synthesis and biosynthesis or the stated LST equivalents.
progression.chemical-biology: Organic Chemistry 1 and 2 or the named LST equivalent.
progression.research-project: Completed first year, at least 130 EC, programme sent for Board approval a month in advance, and coordinator approval.
progression.minor: 30 EC after the completed first year. Can be chosen from the university minors or the two named chemistry minor choices in Appendix II.
